toegepas.blok: Die vaardigheid bly by die mens
toegepas.voor: bied hierdie vaardigheid vir ander mense aan
toegepas.na: bied hierdie vaardigheid aan ander mense
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Iets vir iemand aanbied' follows English 'offer for'; Afrikaans offers something 'aan' someone, and the separable 'aan' then need not be repeated.
toegepas.fout: 'iets vir iemand aanbied' copies English 'offer for'; Afrikaans offers something 'aan' someone
toegepas.rede_keurder: In both versions the hairdresser offers the skill to other people, so the meaning is the same and the proposal is the natural Afrikaans construction.

toegepas.voor: om gesond te word en 'n onderwyser
toegepas.na: om gesond te word, en 'n onderwyser
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it; the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Dokter help' and 'n onderwyser leer' are two full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma, and the protected wording stays intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences with their own subject and verb, so it takes a comma.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Loodgieter maak' and 'n taxibestuurder ry' are two full clauses, so the comma is required, and it matches the comma kept in change 3.

toegepas.blok: Dienste wat oor 'n grens verkoop word
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence draws the conclusion from the visitor example, and 'So' links it to the previous sentence so it does not read as an unconnected new claim.
toegepas.fout: the sentence states the conclusion with no link to the visitor example, so it reads as an unconnected new claim
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So' only makes the existing inference explicit, adds no fact, and leaves the protected wording 'sonder dat 'n vrag die land verlaat' intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Die vaardigheid bly by die mens
laat_vaar.voor: die werk wat met die vaardigheid gedoen is
laat_vaar.na: die werk wat met die vaardigheid gedoen word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: This is a general statement about what a service is, so the present passive 'gedoen word' fits better than the perfect 'gedoen is'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The perfect 'gedoen is' matches the finished haircut in the sentence before it, so the swap is a lateral move and the original reads well.

na_skrywer.voor: , wat 'n mens deur leer of oefening kry.
na_skrywer.na: . 'n Mens kry dit deur te leer of te oefen.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The relative 'wat' can attach to 'iets' rather than to 'die vermoë'; a separate sentence with 'dit' makes the reference clear and matches the study block's wording.
na_skrywer.fout: the relative 'wat' could attach to 'iets' rather than to 'die vermoë', and the glossary wording differs from the study block's
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition, and rewording it beyond a plain grammar fix belongs to the writer, who has to keep it the same in every lesson.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Dienste wat oor 'n grens verkoop word / toerisme
vlae.teks: Toerisme is wanneer mense vir 'n kort tyd reis na 'n plek buite hulle gewone lewe: nie waar hulle woon, werk of skool gaan nie.
vlae.rede: More natural Afrikaans word order would be 'vir 'n kort tyd na 'n plek ... reis', and 'is wanneer' is a weak definition form; not changed because the identical sentence stands in the study block and in the glossary, which must stay identical, so a single change cannot be applied to only one of them. A person or the writer should decide for both at once.
